title: Sai Pallavi's Role in Ramayana: Casting Controversy
summary: Sai Pallavi, who played the role of Sita in a recent adaptation of Ramayana, has been at the center of controversy over her casting. The issue has sparked debate among fans and critics alike, with some questioning whether she was suitable for the role. The controversy surrounding her casting has also led to discussions about representation and diversity in Indian cinema.
summary_points: Sai Pallavi played the lead role of Sita in a recent adaptation of Ramayana
The casting of Sai Pallavi has sparked debate among fans and critics
Some have questioned whether she was suitable for the role due to her Telugu background
The controversy has led to discussions about representation and diversity in Indian cinema
